name: star-wars-galactic-racer-1-5-million-players-20261114
lines:
لعبة السباقات Galactic Racer
من عالم Star Wars

حسب بوش سكوير (Push Square)،
أعلن استوديو فيوز غيمز (Fuse Games) الرقم

ويقول الموقع إن من غير الواضح
إن كان الرقم مبيعات أم لاعبين
headline: مليون ونصف لاعب
label: تقرير

angle.hook: a Star Wars racing game reports 1.5 million players more than a month after launch, a figure Push Square says Fuse Games announced, with Push Square noting it is unclear whether it counts sales or players
angle.why_now: the team posted the milestone on 13 Nov, exactly one month after the 6 Oct launch, and Push Square carried it the same evening; no Arabic outlet has it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players can buy it on Steam at 165 AED in the UAE and 159 SR in Saudi Arabia, and Arabic is among its supported languages
angle.payoff: the team teases more about the game's future but announces no plans, so the milestone is the only confirmed news

bed_reason: Trailer sound unusable for all five official Steam trailers of STAR WARS: Galactic Racer (appid 4078430), checked 13 Nov with faster-whisper small (vad on and off) and the server's Cocktail Fork stem check: the Launch Trailer's speech-free stretches carry effects (music stem leftover 5.8% at 44.96 s and 16.0% at 0 s, over the 5% limit; music 38.6% and 42.2%), and it is narrated at 35.5-42.7, 69-87 and 118-130 s with burnt-in subtitles from 88 s; the Official Gameplay Trailer is narrated at 2.5-17, 31-33 and 53-60 s; the Announcement Trailer is narrated at 1-10 s and onward; the Official Story Trailer is narrated at 4.5-54.7 and 65.5-80.6 s; the Release Date Reveal has no speech but only about 11 clean seconds before burnt-in dates and Deluxe Edition captions. No other official copy was reachable.
